title: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Mecha Genteiban: Hatsubai 5 Shuunen Toku Package
native_title: アイドル雀士スーチーパイめちゃ限定版 ～発売５周年「得」パッケージ～
overview:
A nudity-free compilation from the Suchie-Pai series, this four-disc set includes the following:

• Disc 1: A non-nude version of Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special.
• Disc 2: A non-nude version of Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai II.
• Disc 3: A new Adventure game, similar to Suchie-Pai Adventure: Doki Doki Nightmare, in which the Pai team sets out to find a ghost in the school. Also contains extras, such as a replica of Jaleco's then-current site's voice actress page.
• Disc 4: A mini audio CD.
